Programming Concepts.title: Programming Concepts
Programming Concepts.content:
Programming Concepts

Programming includes sequence, selection, and iteration, which help solve problems logically.

Core idea

Programs are written to accept input, process it, and generate output efficiently.

Number Systems.title: Number Systems
Number Systems.content:
Number Systems

Number systems explain how computers represent values using different bases such as binary, decimal, and hexadecimal.

Use

This helps in memory addressing, programming, and digital design.

Boolean Logic.title: Boolean Logic
Boolean Logic.content:
Boolean Logic

Boolean logic forms the base of digital circuits and decision making in programming.

Applications

It is used in logic gates, conditions, and circuit design.

Data Types.title: Data Types
Data Types.content:
Data Types

Data types define the kind of values stored in variables, such as integers, strings, and booleans.

Examples

Understanding data types helps avoid incorrect results and improve program reliability.

Computer Hardware.title: Computer Hardware
Computer Hardware.content:
Computer Hardware

Hardware includes all physical components such as the CPU, memory, storage, and input/output devices.

Function

Each device plays a specific role in processing and using data.

Software and Operating Systems.title: Software and Operating Systems
Software and Operating Systems.content:
Software and Operating Systems

Software includes programs that run on a computer, while the operating system manages system resources and user interaction.
